title: Street Repair
description: Use this service request to report minor street repairs such as pot holes, standing water, damaged surface, broken curbs and gutters. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

observedQuestions.question: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for minor nonhazardous street repair.
actions.why: For minor nonhazardous street repairs, including potholes, damaged pavement, standing water, broken curbs or gutters, bridge or shoulder repair, culverts, grading, retaining walls, or a street wheelchair ramp. The 311 request form asks whether the issue is hazardous, the repair type, direction of travel, and nearest business or intersection.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Street Repair" requests is not the directed route for a hazardous condition. If the condition is hazardous, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Street Repair"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Street Repair"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a hazardous street-repair concern.
actions.why: For a hazardous street repair. The Street Repair request form directs people who answer Yes to its hazardous question to call 3-1-1.
